sentences.text: The appellant having sustained accidental injuries on 17.04.2015 filed a claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act claiming just and proper compensation, and the Tribunal although awarded Rs.1,74,998.50/-, however, in the operative portion of the award, the total compensation amount is shown as Rs.1,64,999/-.
Claimant is in appeal seeking enhancement of compensation.

3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4.
The claimant having sustained accidental injuries in a road traffic accident is not disputed and the claimant was aged 48 years as on the date of the accident.
The claimant sustained the following injuries in the road traffic accident.
"Comminuted fracture anterior and lateral wall of right maxillary sinus seen.

sentences.text: The wound certificate at Ex.P7 is not disputed.
Although, the doctor was not examined to assess the functional disability of the appellant/claimant.

However, having regard to the nature of injuries,
the claimant has suffered functional disability.

Therefore, having regard to the nature of injuries sustained and the avocation of the claimant who is an agriculturist, the claimant is entitled for total compensation amount of Rs.2,75,000/- as against Rs.1,64,999/- awarded by the Tribunal.
The enhanced compensation amount of Rs.1,10,000/- shall carry interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realization.
To this extent the impugned award passed by the Tribunal stands modified.
